{\footnotesize\ttfamily \mbox{\hyperlink{interfaceenum}{enum}} \mbox{\hyperlink{drm__dp__helper_8h_a4e9df22673431799f8b125fa70b60883}{dp\+\_\+colorimetry}}}

enum dp\+\_\+colorimetry -\/ drm DP Colorimetry formats

This enum is used to indicate DP V\+SC S\+DP Colorimetry formats. It is based on DP 1.\+4 spec \mbox{[}Table 2-\/117\+: V\+SC S\+DP Payload for D\+B16 through D\+B18\mbox{]} and a name of enum member follows D\+R\+M\+\_\+\+M\+O\+D\+E\+\_\+\+C\+O\+L\+O\+R\+I\+M\+E\+T\+RY definition.

@\+D\+P\+\_\+\+C\+O\+L\+O\+R\+I\+M\+E\+T\+R\+Y\+\_\+\+D\+E\+F\+A\+U\+LT\+: s\+R\+GB (I\+EC 61966-\/2-\/1) or I\+T\+U-\/R B\+T.\+601 colorimetry format @\+D\+P\+\_\+\+C\+O\+L\+O\+R\+I\+M\+E\+T\+R\+Y\+\_\+\+R\+G\+B\+\_\+\+W\+I\+D\+E\+\_\+\+F\+I\+X\+ED\+: R\+GB wide gamut fixed point colorimetry format @\+D\+P\+\_\+\+C\+O\+L\+O\+R\+I\+M\+E\+T\+R\+Y\+\_\+\+B\+T709\+\_\+\+Y\+CC\+: I\+T\+U-\/R B\+T.\+709 colorimetry format @\+D\+P\+\_\+\+C\+O\+L\+O\+R\+I\+M\+E\+T\+R\+Y\+\_\+\+R\+G\+B\+\_\+\+W\+I\+D\+E\+\_\+\+F\+L\+O\+AT\+: R\+GB wide gamut floating point (sc\+R\+GB (I\+EC 61966-\/2-\/2)) colorimetry format @\+D\+P\+\_\+\+C\+O\+L\+O\+R\+I\+M\+E\+T\+R\+Y\+\_\+\+X\+V\+Y\+C\+C\+\_\+601\+: xv\+Y\+C\+C601 colorimetry format @\+D\+P\+\_\+\+C\+O\+L\+O\+R\+I\+M\+E\+T\+R\+Y\+\_\+\+O\+P\+R\+GB\+: Op\+R\+GB colorimetry format @\+D\+P\+\_\+\+C\+O\+L\+O\+R\+I\+M\+E\+T\+R\+Y\+\_\+\+X\+V\+Y\+C\+C\+\_\+709\+: xv\+Y\+C\+C709 colorimetry format @\+D\+P\+\_\+\+C\+O\+L\+O\+R\+I\+M\+E\+T\+R\+Y\+\_\+\+D\+C\+I\+\_\+\+P3\+\_\+\+R\+GB\+: D\+C\+I-\/\+P3 (S\+M\+P\+TE RP 431-\/2) colorimetry format @\+D\+P\+\_\+\+C\+O\+L\+O\+R\+I\+M\+E\+T\+R\+Y\+\_\+\+S\+Y\+C\+C\+\_\+601\+: s\+Y\+C\+C601 colorimetry format @\+D\+P\+\_\+\+C\+O\+L\+O\+R\+I\+M\+E\+T\+R\+Y\+\_\+\+R\+G\+B\+\_\+\+C\+U\+S\+T\+OM\+: R\+GB Custom Color Profile colorimetry format @\+D\+P\+\_\+\+C\+O\+L\+O\+R\+I\+M\+E\+T\+R\+Y\+\_\+\+O\+P\+Y\+C\+C\+\_\+601\+: op\+Y\+C\+C601 colorimetry format @\+D\+P\+\_\+\+C\+O\+L\+O\+R\+I\+M\+E\+T\+R\+Y\+\_\+\+B\+T2020\+\_\+\+R\+GB\+: I\+T\+U-\/R B\+T.\+2020 R\textquotesingle{} G\textquotesingle{} B\textquotesingle{} colorimetry format @\+D\+P\+\_\+\+C\+O\+L\+O\+R\+I\+M\+E\+T\+R\+Y\+\_\+\+B\+T2020\+\_\+\+C\+Y\+CC\+: I\+T\+U-\/R B\+T.\+2020 Y\textquotesingle{}c C\textquotesingle{}bc C\textquotesingle{}rc colorimetry format @\+D\+P\+\_\+\+C\+O\+L\+O\+R\+I\+M\+E\+T\+R\+Y\+\_\+\+B\+T2020\+\_\+\+Y\+CC\+: I\+T\+U-\/R B\+T.\+2020 Y\textquotesingle{} C\textquotesingle{}b C\textquotesingle{}r colorimetry format \doxysubsubsection{\texorpdfstring{drm\_dp\_quirk}{drm\_dp\_quirk}}
{\footnotesize\ttfamily \mbox{\hyperlink{interfaceenum}{enum}} \mbox{\hyperlink{drm__dp__helper_8h_af51f31428d96b1010d258262573f8fe5}{drm\+\_\+dp\+\_\+quirk}}}

enum drm\+\_\+dp\+\_\+quirk -\/ Display Port sink/branch device specific quirks

Display Port sink and branch devices in the wild have a variety of bugs, try to collect them here. \mbox{\hyperlink{classThe}{The}} quirks are shared, but it\textquotesingle{}s up to the drivers to implement workarounds for them. \begin{DoxyEnumFields}{Enumerator}
\raisebox{\heightof{T}}[0pt][0pt]{\index{DP\_DPCD\_QUIRK\_CONSTANT\_N@{DP\_DPCD\_QUIRK\_CONSTANT\_N}!drm\_dp\_helper.h@{drm\_dp\_helper.h}}\index{drm\_dp\_helper.h@{drm\_dp\_helper.h}!DP\_DPCD\_QUIRK\_CONSTANT\_N@{DP\_DPCD\_QUIRK\_CONSTANT\_N}}}\mbox{\Hypertarget{drm__dp__helper_8h_af51f31428d96b1010d258262573f8fe5aff39a5808286251eb53e8b582a0c32ce}\label{drm__dp__helper_8h_af51f31428d96b1010d258262573f8fe5aff39a5808286251eb53e8b582a0c32ce}} 
D\+P\+\_\+\+D\+P\+C\+D\+\_\+\+Q\+U\+I\+R\+K\+\_\+\+C\+O\+N\+S\+T\+A\+N\+T\+\_\+N&@\+D\+P\+\_\+\+D\+P\+C\+D\+\_\+\+Q\+U\+I\+R\+K\+\_\+\+C\+O\+N\+S\+T\+A\+N\+T\+\_\+N\+:

\mbox{\hyperlink{classThe}{The}} device requires main link attributes Mvid and Nvid to be limited to 16 bits. So will give a constant value (0x8000) for compatability. \\
\hline

\raisebox{\heightof{T}}[0pt][0pt]{\index{DP\_DPCD\_QUIRK\_NO\_PSR@{DP\_DPCD\_QUIRK\_NO\_PSR}!drm\_dp\_helper.h@{drm\_dp\_helper.h}}\index{drm\_dp\_helper.h@{drm\_dp\_helper.h}!DP\_DPCD\_QUIRK\_NO\_PSR@{DP\_DPCD\_QUIRK\_NO\_PSR}}}\mbox{\Hypertarget{drm__dp__helper_8h_af51f31428d96b1010d258262573f8fe5ad6f7868910975bd1ee4675a69dc7cc8c}\label{drm__dp__helper_8h_af51f31428d96b1010d258262573f8fe5ad6f7868910975bd1ee4675a69dc7cc8c}} 
D\+P\+\_\+\+D\+P\+C\+D\+\_\+\+Q\+U\+I\+R\+K\+\_\+\+N\+O\+\_\+\+P\+SR&@\+D\+P\+\_\+\+D\+P\+C\+D\+\_\+\+Q\+U\+I\+R\+K\+\_\+\+N\+O\+\_\+\+P\+SR\+:

\mbox{\hyperlink{classThe}{The}} device does not support P\+SR even if reports that it supports or driver still need to implement proper handling for such device. \\
\hline

\raisebox{\heightof{T}}[0pt][0pt]{\index{DP\_DPCD\_QUIRK\_NO\_SINK\_COUNT@{DP\_DPCD\_QUIRK\_NO\_SINK\_COUNT}!drm\_dp\_helper.h@{drm\_dp\_helper.h}}\index{drm\_dp\_helper.h@{drm\_dp\_helper.h}!DP\_DPCD\_QUIRK\_NO\_SINK\_COUNT@{DP\_DPCD\_QUIRK\_NO\_SINK\_COUNT}}}\mbox{\Hypertarget{drm__dp__helper_8h_af51f31428d96b1010d258262573f8fe5ad93cafa0e392406c38e53f049d31fa18}\label{drm__dp__helper_8h_af51f31428d96b1010d258262573f8fe5ad93cafa0e392406c38e53f049d31fa18}} 
D\+P\+\_\+\+D\+P\+C\+D\+\_\+\+Q\+U\+I\+R\+K\+\_\+\+N\+O\+\_\+\+S\+I\+N\+K\+\_\+\+C\+O\+U\+NT&@\+D\+P\+\_\+\+D\+P\+C\+D\+\_\+\+Q\+U\+I\+R\+K\+\_\+\+N\+O\+\_\+\+S\+I\+N\+K\+\_\+\+C\+O\+U\+NT\+:

\mbox{\hyperlink{classThe}{The}} device does not set S\+I\+N\+K\+\_\+\+C\+O\+U\+NT to a non-\/zero value. \mbox{\hyperlink{classThe}{The}} driver should ignore S\+I\+N\+K\+\_\+\+C\+O\+U\+NT during detection. Note that \mbox{\hyperlink{drm__dp__helper_8h_a28e2778ee7f5e0fd6e728c71ea5caa11}{drm\+\_\+dp\+\_\+read\+\_\+sink\+\_\+count\+\_\+cap()}} automatically checks for this quirk. \\
\hline

\raisebox{\heightof{T}}[0pt][0pt]{\index{DP\_DPCD\_QUIRK\_DSC\_WITHOUT\_VIRTUAL\_DPCD@{DP\_DPCD\_QUIRK\_DSC\_WITHOUT\_VIRTUAL\_DPCD}!drm\_dp\_helper.h@{drm\_dp\_helper.h}}\index{drm\_dp\_helper.h@{drm\_dp\_helper.h}!DP\_DPCD\_QUIRK\_DSC\_WITHOUT\_VIRTUAL\_DPCD@{DP\_DPCD\_QUIRK\_DSC\_WITHOUT\_VIRTUAL\_DPCD}}}\mbox{\Hypertarget{drm__dp__helper_8h_af51f31428d96b1010d258262573f8fe5a91f7f5504ccc78ec0777e756ddc544be}\label{drm__dp__helper_8h_af51f31428d96b1010d258262573f8fe5a91f7f5504ccc78ec0777e756ddc544be}}

\mbox{\hyperlink{classThe}{The}} device supports M\+ST D\+SC despite not supporting Virtual D\+P\+CD. \mbox{\hyperlink{classThe}{The}} D\+SC caps can be read from the physical aux instead. \\

\mbox{\hyperlink{drm__dp__helper_8h_a27b7e8363951a9096ee25cf91738672d}{drm\+\_\+edp\+\_\+backlight\+\_\+supported()}} -\/ Check an e\+DP D\+P\+CD for V\+E\+SA backlight support @edp\+\_\+dpcd\+: \mbox{\hyperlink{classThe}{The}} D\+P\+CD to check

Note that currently this function will return false for panels which support various D\+P\+CD backlight features but which require the brightness be set through P\+WM, and don\textquotesingle{}t support setting the brightness level via the D\+P\+CD. This is a T\+O\+DO.

Returns\+: True if @edp\+\_\+dpcd indicates that V\+E\+SA backlight controls are supported, false otherwise \mbox{\Hypertarget{drm__dp__helper_8h_a1a210f862ccd1a8e1e0682b8872e1663}\label{drm__dp__helper_8h_a1a210f862ccd1a8e1e0682b8872e1663}}
